verdicts.reason: A: 'Every mixed case.' sits right up against '20% off' with almost no gap, which reads as a collision. The product is tiny and its circle is cramped against the CTA, and the legal text floats alone at the far right. B: the subcopy has a proper gutter and the circle fits cleanly, but the legal line butts right up against the circle and leaves a dead strip on the right. In both, the product is shrunk to an icon and the 3-line subcopy wraps awkwardly.
